source.name: Cincinnati Business Courier – 'Mercy Health signs on as top FC Cincinnati sponsor' (via Wayback Machine)
source.quote: Mercy Health, the largest hospital system in Ohio, today revealed it will be the official jersey sponsor of FC Cincinnati.
source.note: The deal was revealed on 13 November 2017; Mercy Health has been the club's jersey (front) sponsor since. The live bizjournals page blocks scripted access, so the Wayback capture is cited. End date and value were not disclosed.
